acceptance_criteria.criterion: Viewer.JumpTo() reads #field-jumper, calls ajax=resolvePageNumber, and navigates to data.data.viewURL on success
Viewer.JumpTo() shows an alert on server-side error and re-enables the Go button
Viewer.JumpTo() shows an alert on network/AJAX error and re-enables the Go button
After the modal opens, #field-jumper is focused and its value is selected
The { once: true } listener prevents handler accumulation on repeated modal opens

summary: Reworked Viewer.JumpTo() in js/viewer.js: parseInt validation, Go button disable/enable on flight, correct data.data.message error path.
Added full ShowJumpToModal() with shown.bs.modal { once: true } listener that focuses and selects #field-jumper after modal appears.
Constructor already had this.ajaxBaseURL — no constructor changes needed.

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent with the existing Viewer class patterns.

summary: All 8 acceptance criteria verified against js/viewer.js implementation.

JumpTo(): reads #field-jumper with parseInt(), disables Go button, calls ajaxBaseURL+'&ajax=resolvePageNumber&pageNumber='+pageNumber, navigates to data.data.viewURL on success, shows alert and re-enables Go on both server-side and network errors.
ShowJumpToModal(): creates bootstrap.Modal and calls show(); attaches shown.bs.modal listener with { once: true } to focus and select #field-jumper after animation.
Form onsubmit wiring (event.preventDefault(); viewer.JumpTo()) confirmed in ReaderPage.php renderImages() modal HTML.
sendAJAXSuccess/sendAJAXResponse confirmed to wrap payload as { state, data } — data.data.viewURL and data.data.message paths are correct.
PHPStan: no errors (138 files). PHPUnit: 60/60 pass (1 pre-existing deprecation, 1 pre-existing skip — both unrelated to this feature).

comments.note: js/viewer.js ShowJumpToModal(): uses new bootstrap.Modal(el) on every invocation instead of bootstrap.Modal.getOrCreateInstance(el). Functionally correct but getOrCreateInstance is the canonical safe pattern for repeated modal opens. Pre-existing note from code-review pipeline — no action needed here.

JumpTo() disables the Go button but does not re-enable it on successful navigation (document.location assignment). This is correct — re-enabling is unnecessary since the page navigates away. Confirmed intentional.
No observations beyond the above — code is clean, correct, and consistent with existing Viewer class patterns.

summary: Reviewed js/viewer.js JumpTo() and ShowJumpToModal() methods, ReaderPage.php modal HTML, and ajax_resolvePageNumber() handler. All 8 acceptance criteria confirmed met. Code is clean, idiomatic, and consistent with the existing Viewer class patterns. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: js/viewer.js JumpTo(): `const viewer = this;` is declared but never referenced in any callback body — callbacks use $('#jumpToModal .btn-primary') directly and reference this.ajaxBaseURL before entering callbacks. Dead variable; harmless, and consistent with the defensive pattern in SetFlag(), but could be cleaned up.
js/viewer.js JumpTo(): uses `error` callback (correct jQuery API). This implicitly fixes the pre-existing `'failure'` typo used in SetFlag(). The improvement is silent but good — no action needed.

js/viewer.js ShowJumpToModal(): `new bootstrap.Modal(el)` vs `bootstrap.Modal.getOrCreateInstance(el)` — carried forward from QA note. Functionally correct; getOrCreateInstance is the canonical safe pattern if the modal is opened repeatedly. Low priority, no action required.

ReaderPage.php modal footer: Go button is targeted via `$('#jumpToModal .btn-primary')` selector. Slightly fragile if a second .btn-primary were added to the footer, but the single-action modal structure makes this acceptable. Consistent with jQuery selector patterns used elsewhere in the file.

summary: Updated data-flows.md Jump To Episode AJAX Flow to accurately reflect the WP-002 implementation: (1) added shown.bs.modal { once: true } listener documenting the focus/select behaviour after modal animation; (2) added Go button disable/re-enable flow; (3) corrected error alert format to 'Error: ' + textStatus + ', ' + error; (4) corrected on-state-error path to data.data.message || 'Invalid page number'. api-surface.md required no changes — ajax_resolvePageNumber() was already documented by WP-001 Documentation and no new PHP classes or methods were added.

comments.note: The js/viewer.js Viewer class is not documented in api-surface.md (which is PHP-only). The Jump To flow is fully captured in data-flows.md. No gap — consistent with the existing convention of documenting JS behaviour via flows rather than an API surface table.

notes: All 8 AC verified met. PHPStan clean. 60/60 PHPUnit pass.
